decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, costs little to keep listed, and its value is still unresolved after only two years, so the option is worth holding.
The centrifuge builds on the established filtration business and fits the firm's sustainability focus, so keeping it is cheap and its prospects remain open.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the core metalworking offer and carries a low cost to keep, and nothing in its results shows that its value has failed to materialize.
Hinged belt conveyors are a staple of chip handling, so the product carries little cost to keep, and since the firm has already pruned weaker lines this option is worth retaining.
